amends: v1.1 base plan; independent of v1.2 identity injection
axis: orthogonal — every condition scored with AND without reranking from the same retrieval call on the same queries (paired). NOT a new condition.
decides_on: Track A (220 queries) and Track B (150 queries), existing v1.1 splits. No new corpus.

reranker.pool_source: index.candidate_pool — identical first-stage candidates with and without rerank
reranker.reranks: the fused candidate pool, then cuts to top-k (reranking only the top-k could never change recall@k)

hypotheses.H6: X+rerank recall@5 > X for each condition X; paired CI excludes 0 after Holm
hypotheses.H6a: interaction via difference-in-differences (C3+rr - C3) - (C0+rr - C0); ~0 = additive/complements, <0 = sub-additive/substitutes, >0 = super-additive
hypotheses.H6b: secondary/descriptive: C0+rerank vs C3 — does a query-side fix reach the corpus-side fix's result?

reporting_rule: H6a is reported in whichever direction it falls. A negative DiD is evidence for the composition story (substitutes, not complements) and must not be suppressed in favour of the direction favouring the formatter.
holm_families: H6 main-effect comparisons form their OWN Holm family, separate from the v1.1 H1-H4 pairwise family; merging them would retroactively change the significance of published v1.1 results

decision_rules.ADOPT: H6 significant on BOTH tracks for the primary metric, on at least C0 and C3
decision_rules.ADOPT_SCOPED: significant on one track only or a subset of conditions — state the scope
decision_rules.KILL: gain not statistically distinguishable from zero on Track A AND Track B

kill_means_stop: on KILL, do NOT seek a third corpus to chase significance — that repeats the error the one-shot rule exists to prevent. A null is reported as a result.
one_shot_rule: if H6 fails, changing model or pool size and re-testing on the same A/B test split is not a fresh test; a retry needs a pre-registered amendment

invariants_enforced_in_code.provenance: assert_permutation runs in-band on every rerank call; any change to the unit set, text, or source_ranges raises ProvenanceViolation
invariants_enforced_in_code.no_resize: no Unit is constructed; compute_chunk_stats asserted invariant in tests
invariants_enforced_in_code.off_is_noop: rerank.enabled=false reproduces every pre-v1.3 number exactly

addenda.clarification: Holm family for H6 main effect = PRIMARY conditions C0-C5 only. The C3-* ablations and C4i are diagnostics and are reported uncorrected and explicitly non-decision-bearing.
addenda.why: The frozen prereg said H6 forms its own Holm family but did not enumerate conditions; the decision rule references C0 and C3. Correcting across all ~11 conditions would be conservative in proportion to family size rather than to evidence, and could produce a KILL for a bookkeeping reason.
addenda.integrity_note: Recorded while the first reranked run was still executing; no reranked result had been observed. This is an interpretation of the frozen protocol, not a change to its criteria — the ADOPT/KILL rules are untouched.
